summary: Verified Google OAuth first-login race fix. Mocked POST /api/auth/google (page.route + real access_token cookie injected via context.add_cookies before fulfilling). 3 runs (0s, 1.5s, 0.5s delays): all landed on /dashboard on first try, header shows Dashboard/Admin/Log out, and ZERO /api/auth/me requests were made during the OAuth return (network log only shows POST /auth/google). sessionStorage giftaol_next=/gifts/new -> landed on /gifts/new logged in (guest email field hidden). Mocked 401 -> /login in logged-out state (Sign in shown, not stuck loading). GET /api/auth/me anon -> 200 null (also with bogus cookie / bogus Bearer); logged in -> user. Regression: protected /dashboard -> /login?next=%2Fdashboard, password login UI -> /dashboard, logout -> Sign in, guest /gifts/new shows email field. Hack monitor: no 401 /api/auth/me entries since the fix (last 401s at 19:38-19:39 predate tests; all subsequent /auth/me logged as 200). Backend pytest 24/24 passed after updating 2 tests that expected 401.

issues:
When /api/auth/google fails, AuthCallback sets an error then immediately navigates to /login; the error

is never visible and no toast is shown, so the user gets no feedback why Google sign-in failed. Consider toast.error(errMsg(e)) before navigate.

action_items: Optional: show a toast on Google login failure (AuthCallback catch) since the inline error is never seen.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.js fromOAuth ref is captured at first render before AuthCallback clears hash - correct; StrictMode safe (done ref in AuthCallback prevents double POST, verified only 1 POST per run).
fromOAuth ref never resets; if a user later calls refresh() it works since refresh is exposed - fine.
/auth/me returns null for anon, invalid JWT, wrong token type - no 401 noise.
context_for_next_testing_agent: OAuth return mocked by page.route('**/api/auth/google') fulfilling the admin user JSON after ctx.add_cookies(access_token from API password login). Network listener on /api/auth/ confirmed no /auth/me calls during OAuth return.
